reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by artsy/palette-mobile (https://github.com/artsy/palette-mobile).
Technology stack: react-native.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: README 标题是 Palette Mobile，章节里排着 What is Palette?、Looking for home view components?、How to install、Deploying to TestFlight and Play Store；仓库里 screenshots 与 docs 两个目录并排，docs 的那条提交是 add darkmode docs，scripts 下有 release palette-mobile to play store 与 publish palette-mobile to testflight，依赖同步跟着 React Native 与 Expo 版本走，最新版本 v24.12.0。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
